tickets.title: Prepare spring tuition funding schedule
tickets.text: Prepare a month-by-month schedule for Mira and Adrian Quillwhistle showing how much of the Marzipan Meadow College charges for Elin can come from Elin's 529 at Velvet Acorn Custody, the Teacup Comet Bank tuition set-aside, and the Paper Otter Custody Treasury fund without changing retirement contributions.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that schedule by December 19, 2023.

tickets.title: Obtain Marzipan Meadow itemized billing packet
tickets.text: Obtain the itemized student account PDF from Marzipan Meadow College for Elin Quillwhistle to substantiate the payment plan and qualified expense categories, since the portal screenshot showed tuition, housing, meal plan, and health fee lines but not the itemized PDF.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain the itemized billing packet by December 12, 2023.

tickets.title: Resolve Elin 529 balance mismatch
tickets.text: Resolve the balance mismatch for Elin Quillwhistle's 529 account at Velvet Acorn Custody, where the mobile screenshot showed $67,400 while the downloaded statement showed $72,270 for the same account, creating uncertainty about the amount available for the next payment.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to resolve the balance mismatch by December 15, 2023.

tickets.title: Identify 529 payment workflow for Marzipan Meadow
tickets.text: Identify an acceptable direct payment or reimbursement workflow for Elin Quillwhistle's Marzipan Meadow College charges after the college portal rejected bank verification for direct 529 payment and displayed an error after two attempts.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to identify the payment or reimbursement workflow by December 18, 2023.

tickets.title: Prepare Rowan education funding projection
tickets.text: Prepare a separate education funding projection for Rowan Quillwhistle using the existing 529 balance at Velvet Acorn Custody, expected test and application costs, and a first-year college savings target that does not rely on borrowing.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that projection by December 29, 2023.

tickets.title: Prepare Rowan cost-gap estimate
tickets.text: Prepare a cost-gap estimate for Rowan Quillwhistle's college list before the first school deposit decision so Mira and Adrian can compare merit aid offers consistently, using the counselor's scholarship response calendar.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the cost-gap estimate by February 2, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare Elin off-campus housing projection
tickets.text: Prepare a projection for Elin Quillwhistle's potential off-campus housing (apartment with two classmates after the dorm contract ends) showing which rent, food, and utility amounts could fit into the education funding plan versus parent cash flow.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that projection by January 19, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare taxable education reserve sale-sequencing and tax estimate
tickets.text: Prepare a sale-sequencing and tax estimate for the Paper Otter Custody taxable account education reserve, considering unrealized gains in the equity index fund and the separate Treasury position earmarked for tuition, before using the reserve.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the sale-sequencing and tax estimate by January 3, 2024.
